text: At the Quillfeather Archive’s winter open house on Tuesday, staff members said the collection was founded by Emeric Volkov, a retired map conservator from East Bryn. Archivist Lila Renwick pointed to a brass plaque near the reading room entrance that names Volkov as the archive’s original donor and organizer in 2009. “He started with three cabinets and a rented storefront,” Renwick told me, while showing a set of early ledger books signed in Volkov’s hand. Volunteer Tomas Ilyin said Volkov spent two years gathering letters, field notes, and parish records before the archive officially opened. By noon, about 40 visitors had passed through the narrow front hall.
